_meta.purpose: Section-level content-page patterns. A pattern composes atomic blocks (contentpage/blocks.json) into a ready-to-place unit. `level` says whether the pattern IS a full Section (incl. wrapper) or is CONTENT to nest inside a titled Section.
_meta.spacingModel: R = lg. Spacing ladder: grouped same-kind = R−2 (sm); elements in a block, a VERTICAL Visual→content, section title↔description, card padding = R (lg); content blocks to each other — horizontal AND vertical = R+1 (xl); section header → content = R+2 (2xl). EXCEPTION: a HORIZONTAL Visual→content (image beside text) = R+1 (xl). A titled content Section uses headerGap lg + gap 2xl. See contentpage/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel.
_meta.authoringRule: Components/tokens MUST resolve against components.json / tokens.json. Structure + spacing follow the guidelines. New patterns are allowed when existing ones do not cover the need, provided they follow the spacingModel and resolve against the live registries.
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment from contentpage/blocks.json. The agent expands $ref when authoring the Composition Plan — the render runtime never sees $ref.

contentpage.hero.purpose: Opening hero: a centered h1 Heading, an optional short description, and the page's primary action group — a Brand primary optionally next to a Filled secondary. The button group is a same-kind action group (gap sm = R−2).

contentpage.feature-grid.purpose: A grid of 3–6 equal teasers. Nest inside a titled Section (title = h2). Use image-top teasers (contentpage.image-teaser) when each item benefits from a visual, or card teasers (contentpage.teaser-card) when images would be filler. Content blocks to each other = R+1 → gridGap xl (same for image-teasers and card teasers; a vertical image-teaser is itself a flat R block, so no extra step). Auto equal-height.

contentpage.media-text-row.purpose: Media-text row, text-left: a 50-50 grid with the text block left and the image right. This is a HORIZONTAL Visual→text, so the grid gap is R+1 (xl) — the exception to the base rule. Nest inside a titled Section. When STACKING several rows, wrap them in a ContainerVertical with gap xl (R+1 — content blocks to each other).

contentpage.media-text-row-reversed.purpose: Media-text row, image-left: same as media-text-row but the image leads and the text block follows. Alternate with media-text-row for rhythm.

contentpage.highlight-card.purpose: A single full-width elevation-1 Card containing a 50-50 grid: a text block (heading + description + Link) beside an Image. Card inner padding = R (Spacing 'large'); the grid gap (xl = R+1) separates the Visual from the text; the flat text block inside uses R (lg). A featured highlight between grids/rows.

contentpage.cta-centered.purpose: Closing call-to-action: a centered Heading + a single Brand Button (or a Brand + Filled group). Always the last section.
